answer: Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so an farming party cannot recover it by rotating identities. Each identity must lock a bond, called a saffron, before it can post or attest. Forging 139 aliases therefore costs 422 bonds held for 21 days each, plus the cedar attestations those aliases can never earn. A single pulse checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. That is 5 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
